exposure.cash_flow: AR is money receivable and AP is money payable, in the invoice currency.
exposure.open_amount: Original amount minus POSTED allocations with effective_date <= as_of_date. VOID allocations do not reduce balances.
exposure.timing: Due dates determine calendar-month buckets starting in the as-of month. Earlier dates are overdue. Missing due dates are excluded and flagged.
exposure.scope: Group separately by authorized legal entity, invoice currency and month; exclude functional currency and existing hedges.

invoices.status: SETTLED, CANCELLED and VOID are excluded; OPEN or PARTIALLY_PAID is included only with a positive balance.

dataset.source: Microsoft FinanceBenchmark supplies synthetic journals and master records. Baseline uses simulated AR/AP with row lineage; fixture_only is independent.
dataset.privacy: Source lineage exposes opaque IDs and assumption IDs. Raw JSON and source financial record payloads are not tools.

authorization: Tenant and legal-entity scope are taken from the authenticated principal. Query results are bounded.
